headline: 730 new cases, two deaths reported as dengue spreads
summary: A surge in dengue cases continues to impact the country, with 730 new infections recorded in a single day.
details: In the last 24 hours, 730 new dengue cases have been reported across the country.

The spike in infections highlights the ongoing struggle to control the spread of the mosquito-borne illness.
Health authorities continue to monitor the situation as case numbers remain high.

headline_marked: 902 children dead: [[Measles outbreak death toll crosses 900]] in Bangladesh
headline: 902 children dead: Measles outbreak death toll crosses 900 in Bangladesh
summary: Eight more children died within 24 hours as the DGHS reports 798 new infections in the last day alone.
details: According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 902 children have died from measles and measles-like symptoms since March 15.
In the last 24 hours alone, eight more children died and 798 new infections were detected across the country.
The DGHS clarified that while eight children died with measles-like symptoms in the last 24 hours, none of these specific deaths were laboratory-confirmed as measles.
Of the total 902 deaths recorded since March 15, 99 cases were confirmed as measles, while 803 were categorized as suspected measles.
The surge in infections and fatalities continues to put significant pressure on pediatric healthcare services nationwide.
caption:
Over 900 children have died from measles and measles-like symptoms in just five months.

According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 902 children have died from measles and measles-like symptoms since March 15.

In the last 24 hours alone, eight more children died and 798 new infections were detected across the country.

The DGHS clarified that while eight children died with measles-like symptoms in the last 24 hours, none of these specific deaths were laboratory-confirmed as measles.

Of the total 902 deaths recorded since March 15, 99 cases were confirmed as measles, while 803 were categorized as suspected measles.

The surge in infections and fatalities continues to put significant pressure on pediatric healthcare services nationwide.
